tasks.description: Protocol transcript supports ordered assistant parts for text, reasoning, host tool calls, provider tool calls, and provider tool results.
steps: packages/agent/protocol exports an ordered AssistantPart schema and AssistantAgentMessage uses ordered parts instead of separated content/reasoning/toolCalls fields
Host-executed tool calls remain representable and host tool results remain separate ToolResultMessage entries
Provider-executed tool call/result parts can carry providerMetadata without importing provider SDKs
packages/agent/test/protocol/wire.test.ts covers JSON round-trips and invalid payloads for assistant parts

tasks.description: Protocol stream events model the full tool lifecycle with raw input deltas, approvals, execution outcomes, and provider results.
steps: AgentEvent includes ToolInputStart, ToolInputDelta, ToolInputEnd, ToolApprovalRequested, ToolApprovalGranted, ToolApprovalDenied, ToolExecutionStarted, ToolExecutionCompleted, ToolExecutionError, and ProviderToolResult semantics
ToolInputDelta carries raw JSON string fragments and final ToolInputEnd carries a validated ToolCall
Old ToolExecutionStart and ToolExecutionEnd names are removed or renamed with no compatibility aliases
Protocol tests verify all new event variants round-trip through JSON wire values

tasks.description: Agent loop emits the new lifecycle events for simple local tool execution while preserving current execution semantics.
steps: packages/agent/src/loop/run.ts emits ToolExecutionStarted and ToolExecutionCompleted for successful local tools
Tool execution failures emit ToolExecutionError with safe message/code and do not fabricate assistant or tool result messages unless explicitly modeled
AgentEnd messages still contain only protocol transcript messages produced by completed turns
agent-loop tests cover successful local execution and tool failure event ordering

tasks.description: Client state reducer derives rich tool lifecycle state from the new protocol events.
steps: AgentToolRun or replacement state covers input streaming, input ready, approval requested, approved, denied, executing, completed, errored, and provider-executed states
Reducers preserve deterministic timing via injected nowMs only
Reducer tests cover streamed input deltas, approval denial, execution error, provider result, and completed local tool paths
No old ToolExecutionStart/ToolExecutionEnd handling remains

tasks.description: React headless chat projections render richer tool lifecycle states without UI/styling concerns.
steps: AgentChatPart/ChatToolState or replacements expose input streaming, approval, denied, errored, completed, and provider-executed states
toAgentMessages preserves ordered assistant parts and host ToolResultMessage entries correctly
chat-messages and chat-items tests cover ordering, provider-executed parts, denial, and execution errors
Package remains headless and imports no provider SDKs or app UI components

lib/agents/route-handler.ts streams only supported AgentEvent variants

patterns: Protocol schemas use Effect Schema tagged classes/unions in packages/agent/src/protocol/src
Agent loop is stateless and emits AgentEvent streams from packages/agent/src/loop/run.ts
Client reducers are deterministic and receive nowMs via options
React package is headless; app UI/components stay outside packages/react
Package-internal relative imports use explicit .ts extensions
Breaking changes are acceptable for this migration; do not add compatibility aliases solely for old lifecycle event names
nonGoals: Implement host approval UI or policy engine
Add database schema or durable append-store implementation
Add file/resource/artifact typed rendering beyond existing Content/structuredContent
Add provider SDK imports to packages
Add sandbox/runtime isolation for tool execution
projectConstraints: Run pnpm packages:check when touching packages/*
Run pnpm lint, pnpm tsc, and pnpm test:run before finishing
No any, no non-null assertions, no type assertions
Reusable packages stay domain-free and provider/runtime neutral
App/server owns auth, tool policy, provider SDKs, prompts, and product context
Do not use raw JSON parse/stringify in production Effect code; use Effect Schema boundaries
existingImplementation: Current protocol has AssistantAgentMessage with content, toolCalls, and optional reasoning
Current AgentEvent has LLMToolCall, ToolExecutionStart, ToolExecutionEnd, and ToolResult
Current client AgentToolRun has Called, Running, and Completed states
Current React ChatToolState mirrors Called, Running, and Completed
ToolResult already supports structuredContent from MCP result fidelity work
MCP result fidelity preserves structuredContent and maps media blocks into protocol Content
